name: Meguru
source:
"Wow, a gun?! I can't do it, I can't do it! I've never even shot one!"

A college student who doesn't go to class at all and spends her days playing video games. Game nerd.

When she was looking for an interesting game, she was involved in an accident.

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html#meguru]official website[/url]]
